statistical.name: statistical_fidelity
statistical.description: Distributional similarity of synthetic and real data: SDV QualityReport plus per-column and pairwise statistics.

metric_descriptions.sdv_quality_score: SDV QualityReport overall score: mean of Column Shapes and Column Pair Trends (1 = identical).
metric_descriptions.sdv_column_shapes: SDV Column Shapes: mean of KSComplement (numeric) and TVComplement (categorical) per column.
metric_descriptions.sdv_column_pair_trends: SDV Column Pair Trends: mean CorrelationSimilarity / ContingencySimilarity over column pairs.
metric_descriptions.sdv_diagnostic_score: SDV DiagnosticReport: data validity (boundary / category adherence) and table structure.
metric_descriptions.ks_statistic: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic: max distance between the real and synthetic CDFs (0 = identical).
metric_descriptions.wasserstein_normalized: Earth mover's distance between real and synthetic values divided by the real value range.
metric_descriptions.range_coverage: Share of the real [min, max] range covered by the synthetic values.
metric_descriptions.tv_distance: Total variation distance between real and synthetic category frequencies (0 = identical).
metric_descriptions.category_coverage: Share of real categories that appear in the synthetic data.
metric_descriptions.correlation_mean_abs_diff: Mean absolute difference between real and synthetic correlation coefficients over numeric column pairs.
metric_descriptions.cramers_v_mean_abs_diff: Mean absolute difference between real and synthetic Cramér's V over categorical column pairs.
metric_descriptions.column_shapes_score: Mean of 1 - KS (numeric) and 1 - TVD (categorical) over all columns.
metric_descriptions.pair_trends_score: 1 - mean |Δ Spearman| / 2 over numeric column pairs.
metric_descriptions.validity: Share of synthetic rows passing every hard operational rule (bedsynth.validation).

validity.name: validity
validity.description: Share of synthetic rows that satisfy every hard operational rule, with per-rule violation rates.

hard_rules.name: valid_categories
hard_rules.description: All categorical stay attributes take values from their vocabularies.

hard_rules.name: hours_in_range
hard_rules.description: Admission and departure hours are whole hours between 0 and 23.

hard_rules.name: non_negative_values
hard_rules.description: Counts are whole and not negative, bed wait and discharge delay hours are not negative, and none is missing.

hard_rules.name: positive_length_of_stay
hard_rules.description: Every stay lasts at least one hour.

hard_rules.name: elective_booking_lead
hard_rules.description: Elective admissions are booked at least one day in advance.

hard_rules.name: non_elective_unbooked
hard_rules.description: Emergency and transfer admissions have no booking lead time and were never rescheduled.

hard_rules.name: delay_reason_consistent
hard_rules.description: A delay reason is recorded exactly when the departure was delayed ('none' if and only if zero delay hours).

hard_rules.name: delay_within_stay
hard_rules.description: The discharge delay cannot be longer than the stay itself.

hard_rules.name: separation_destination_consistent
hard_rules.description: Stays that end in an internal transfer go to another ward, and only those do.

hard_rules.name: delay_reason_allowed
hard_rules.description: The delay reason is operationally meaningful for the discharge destination.

hard_rules.name: ward_admission_profile
hard_rules.description: The admission source is one the ward accepts.

hard_rules.name: metric_ranges
hard_rules.description: Bed turnaround is 10-1440 min, bed wait at most 96 h, stays at most 180 nights, booking lead at most 365 days and reschedules at most 10.

hard_rules.name: delay_threshold
hard_rules.description: A departure counts as delayed only when it is more than 4 hours after the patient was ready, so recorded delays are either zero or at least 4 hours.

hard_rules.name: rebooking_lead
hard_rules.description: Postponed electives are rebooked at least seven days later, so the booking lead is at least 1 + 7 x times_rescheduled days.

soft_rules.name: elective_admission_hours
soft_rules.description: Elective patients are admitted between 06:00 and 14:59.

soft_rules.name: daytime_departures
soft_rules.description: Patients leave the ward between 07:00 and 22:59.

soft_rules.name: short_elective_wait
soft_rules.description: Elective patients wait at most four hours for their bed.

soft_rules.name: no_paediatric_transfers_out
soft_rules.description: Paediatric stays do not end in an internal transfer.

soft_rules.name: long_delays_for_complex_discharges
soft_rules.description: Discharge delays beyond 72 hours occur only for care-facility or supported-home discharges.

metric_descriptions.hard_valid_rate: Share of rows that pass every hard operational rule (the validity score).
metric_descriptions.hard_violation_rate: Share of rows that violate at least one hard rule.
metric_descriptions.violation_rate: Per rule: share of rows violating that rule.
metric_descriptions.soft_clean_rate: Share of rows that pass every soft (plausibility) rule.

operational.name: operational_patterns
operational.description: Agreement of operational occupancy, scheduling and patient-flow patterns between synthetic and real data (mean of check scores; strata-forced system checks excluded).

calibration.basis: random re-splits of the real data (train + holdout): a pseudo training split vs n rows of the remainder

checks.name: los_by_source
checks.description: Length of stay (days) per admission source: median and p90 (relative error) and KS.
checks.criterion: mean KS <= 0.10 and every source reproduced

checks.name: los_by_ward
checks.description: Length of stay (days) per ward: median and p90 (relative error) and KS.
checks.criterion: mean KS <= 0.10 and every ward reproduced

checks.name: admission_hour_profile_by_source
checks.description: Admission hour-of-day distribution per admission source (total variation distance).
checks.criterion: mean TVD <= 0.10 and every source reproduced

checks.name: discharge_hour_profile
checks.description: Ward departure hour-of-day distribution (total variation distance).

checks.name: before_noon_discharge_share
checks.description: Share of ward departures before noon (absolute difference).

checks.name: weekend_discharge_share
checks.description: Share of ward departures on Saturday or Sunday (absolute difference).

checks.name: delay_prevalence_by_destination
checks.description: Share of delayed departures per discharge destination (absolute difference).
checks.criterion: mean |Δ share| <= 0.05 and every destination reproduced

checks.name: mean_delay_by_reason
checks.description: Mean discharge delay (hours) per delay reason (relative error).
checks.criterion: mean relative error <= 0.20 and every reason reproduced

checks.name: bed_turnaround_distribution
checks.description: Bed turnaround minutes after departure: median and p90 (relative error) and KS.

checks.name: elective_lead_time_distribution
checks.description: Booking lead time (days) of elective admissions: median and p90 (relative error) and KS.

checks.name: elective_reschedule_share
checks.description: Share of elective admissions rescheduled at least once (relative error).

checks.name: relationship_lead_reschedules
checks.description: Spearman correlation of booking lead time with times rescheduled among elective admissions.

checks.name: elective_admission_weekday_profile
checks.description: Admission day-of-week mix of elective admissions, weekend electives included (total variation distance).

checks.name: elective_admission_window_share
checks.description: Share of elective admissions in the 06:00-14:59 admission window (absolute difference).

checks.name: emergency_bed_wait_distribution
checks.description: Bed wait (hours) of emergency admissions: median and p90 (relative error) and KS.

checks.name: source_mix_by_ward
checks.description: Admission source mix (elective / emergency / transfer) per ward (total variation distance).
checks.criterion: mean TVD <= 0.05 and every ward reproduced

checks.name: transfer_out_share_by_ward
checks.description: Share of stays ending in an internal transfer out, per ward (absolute difference).
checks.criterion: mean |Δ share| <= 0.03 and every ward reproduced

privacy.name: privacy
privacy.description: Protection against copying training records: exact matches and distance to closest record compared with unseen real (holdout) rows.
privacy.note: Reference data is simulated: privacy is assessed methodologically (same checks apply to a real extract).

metric_descriptions.exact_match_rate: Share of synthetic rows identical to a training row on all train columns.
metric_descriptions.holdout_exact_match_rate: Share of real holdout rows identical to a training row (natural duplicate baseline).
metric_descriptions.dcr: Distance to closest training record: mean per-column distance (numeric |Δ|/range, category mismatch = 1).
metric_descriptions.dcr_median_ratio: Median synthetic DCR divided by median holdout DCR (>= 1: synthetic rows are no closer than unseen real rows).
metric_descriptions.close_record_share: Share of synthetic rows closer to the training data than the 5th percentile of holdout DCR (expected 0.05).
metric_descriptions.closer_to_training_share: Share of synthetic rows closer to a training row than to a holdout row, with equally sized reference sets (expected 0.5).
metric_descriptions.exact_match_protection: 1 - excess exact-match rate over the holdout baseline.
metric_descriptions.close_record_protection: 1 - excess close-record share over the expected 0.05 (rescaled to [0, 1]).
metric_descriptions.overfitting_protection: min(1, 2 * (1 - closer-to-training share)) - the DCROverfittingProtection formula.
metric_descriptions.sdmetrics_DCRBaselineProtection: sdmetrics: median synthetic DCR relative to random data (cross-check, not scored).
metric_descriptions.sdmetrics_DCROverfittingProtection: sdmetrics: closer-to-training share converted to a score (cross-check, not scored).
metric_descriptions.aggregate_disclosure: TVD of the synthetic vs training joint mix of the generator's allocation strata, next to the holdout vs training TVD (real noise); a ratio well below 1 means exact training frequencies are reproduced (reported, not scored).

ml_utility.name: ml_utility
ml_utility.description: Train-on-synthetic / test-on-real skill relative to train-on-real with the same number of training rows (HistGradientBoosting, real holdout as test set).

tasks.name: los_regression
tasks.description: Predict length of stay (log hours) from admission information.

tasks.name: delayed_discharge_classification
tasks.description: Predict whether the departure will be delayed from admission information and destination.

metric_descriptions.trtr: Train-real-test-real: model trained on a seeded real-train subsample of the same size as the synthetic training set, tested on the real holdout (the reference of every ratio).
metric_descriptions.trtr_full: Train-real-test-real on the full real training split (context; reported when its size differs).
metric_descriptions.tstr: Train-synthetic-test-real: model trained on synthetic data, tested on the real holdout.
metric_descriptions.auc_ratio: (TSTR AUC - 0.5) / (TRTR AUC - 0.5) (clipped to [0, 1]); 0 for a classifier without skill.
metric_descriptions.ap_lift_ratio: (TSTR AP - p) / (TRTR AP - p), p = positive rate of the test set (clipped to [0, 1]); 0 for a classifier without skill.
metric_descriptions.f1: F1 of the positive class at a 0.5 probability threshold (reported, not scored).
metric_descriptions.f1_no_skill: F1 of the all-positive classifier, 2p / (1 + p): an F1 at or below it shows no skill.

optimization.name: optimization
optimization.reason: Optimisation utility is defined on ward_daily (bed and booking decisions).

scenario_coverage.name: scenario_coverage
scenario_coverage.description: Ability to generate every catalogue scenario (fulfilment, strata fidelity) and fidelity of each scenario subset to the matching real subset.

scenarios.name: stays_baseline
scenarios.title: Baseline stays
scenarios.description: Unconditional sample of ward stays reproducing the real admission mix.

scenarios.name: emergency_admissions
scenarios.title: Emergency admissions
scenarios.description: Stays admitted through the emergency department.

scenarios.name: rescheduled_electives
scenarios.title: Rescheduled electives
scenarios.description: Elective admissions that were postponed at least once.
warnings: Stopped sampling {'admission_source': 'elective'}: no row satisfied the validation rules and filters after 21290 sampled rows (96640 requested).
Generated 0 of 400 requested rows after 3 attempt(s) (1 condition combination(s) short); the scenario is rare under model 'tvae': increase max_attempts or relax the conditions/filters.
Low acceptance rate (0.0% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: delayed_discharge_stays
scenarios.title: Delayed discharges
scenarios.description: Stays whose departure was delayed by 4+ hours after the patient was ready to leave.

scenarios.name: long_stay_patients
scenarios.title: Long-stay patients
scenarios.description: Stays of 7 or more nights ('stranded' patients).

scenarios.name: weekend_discharges
scenarios.title: Weekend discharges
scenarios.description: Stays ending on a Saturday or Sunday.

scenarios.name: slow_bed_turnaround
scenarios.title: Slow bed turnaround
scenarios.description: Stays after which the bed took 3+ hours to be ready (deep clean, night/weekend).
warnings: Low acceptance rate (0.8% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: long_bed_waits
scenarios.title: Long emergency bed waits
scenarios.description: Emergency admissions that waited 4+ hours for a bed.
warnings: Low acceptance rate (2.6% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

metric_descriptions.real_support: Rows (and share) of the real reference data that belong to the scenario.
metric_descriptions.strata_mix_tvd: Total variation distance between the output's allocation-strata mix and the real scenario subset's mix (> 0 when the generator had to move quota to other strata).
metric_descriptions.strata_rounding_tvd: Smallest strata-mix TVD an output of that many rows can reach (rounding floor); the rebalancing flag needs a TVD more than strata_tvd_flag above it.
metric_descriptions.combination_coverage: Share of material real combinations (>= 1% of the real scenario subset) present in the synthetic subset (strata-forced when its columns are allocation strata).
metric_descriptions.weighted_combination_coverage: Share of real scenario rows whose combination appears in the synthetic subset.
metric_descriptions.in_scenario_rate: Share of generated rows that satisfy the scenario's conditions and filters.
metric_descriptions.fidelity: quick_quality score of the synthetic scenario subset against the real scenario subset (allocation-strata columns excluded).
metric_descriptions.kpi_means: Mean of each scenario KPI in real vs synthetic subsets, with relative difference.

model_view.name: model_view
model_view.description: Families re-scored on raw model samples (no rejection, no allocation strata): what the model learned on its own. The composite uses the generator output (system view).

composite.name: composite
composite.description: Weighted sum of fidelity, validity, operational, utility and privacy scores (weights from settings.evaluation.composite_weights, renormalised over the components defined for the table; a failed family scores 0 and marks the composite incomplete).

component_descriptions.fidelity: SDV QualityReport overall score (column shapes + column pair trends).
component_descriptions.validity: Share of raw model samples that pass every hard operational rule.
component_descriptions.operational: Mean score of the occupancy / scheduling / patient-flow pattern checks.
component_descriptions.utility: Mean of ML utility (train-synthetic-test-real) and optimisation utility (decision agreement).
component_descriptions.privacy: Distance-to-closest-record based protection against copying training records.

model_card.description: TVAE (variational autoencoder), global model with every constraint group (SDV built-ins + programmable)
